lessons_used: Predictions continued to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 3 of 4 tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 7 tests.
sign_in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
choose_path copy, home redesign, adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types with only a single test.

candidates.title: Desktop Hatching Live Preview Waiting Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a live hatching preview screen prior to rendering completion so users can monitor pet synthesis in real time.
candidates.why: Home rendering step takes median 201s (mean 2336s). Providing a dedicated live preview stage keeps users engaged during the long wait.

waiting.hint: Your pet is currently being synthesized and prepared for your desktop display.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_hatching_preview']

candidates.title: Account Pet Cloud Backup Security Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links your pet companion to cloud backup for session persistence.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your pet to your account cloud backup so your desktop companion is never lost.

guard.reason: Adding an informative account cloud backup hint on the sign-in screen is compliant with all onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 8 support tickets about missing pet data; sign_in hints have a proven track record (3/7 wins, +1.8% avg lift).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Hatching Live Activity Log Display
candidates.change: Displays real-time technical milestones and rendering activity status text during pet generation.
candidates.why: Wait info changes have won 3 of 4 tests on the home step, which currently has a 201s median wait time.

components.text: Status: Synthesizing pet desktop animations and behavioral routines...

guard.reason: Displaying rendering status and activity logs on the waiting screen preserves its function and complies with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets high 201s median wait on home step; home wait_info changes have a high win rate (3/4 wins, +2.6% avg lift).

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Finish Flow
candidates.change: Replaces the finish screen layout with an interactive checklist guiding users through basic pet desktop shortcuts and hide controls.
candidates.why: Completion drops to 68.5% at finish, and support received multiple complaints about unclear post-onboarding pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Learn the essential shortcuts: right-click your pet for controls, drag to move, and double-click to chat.

guard.reason: Updating the home intro screen layout to an interactive shortcuts checklist is permitted within onboarding scope.

candidates.score_note: Targets severe drop at finish (68.5%) backed by support complaints, but new flow changes have shown mixed/unclear overall gains.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Split Verification Layout
candidates.change: Reorganizes the adoption certificate step into a split column layout separating pet details from confirmation buttons.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 66.0% with a mean duration of 1017s.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your pet companion details to proceed to activation.

guard.reason: Reorganizing the adoption certificate into a split layout retains the certificate step and official adoption context.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption step which has high drop-off (66.0%) and high duration; layout changes in other steps perform well but untried here.

candidates.title: Finish Step Companion Desktop Quickstart Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the final intro screen into a stage layout with pet preview showcase and active launch trigger.
candidates.why: 395s median duration and 68.5% completion at finish show friction when completing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Desktop Pet
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Click below to complete setup and start interacting.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro step layout into a stage preview with a launch button is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High drop step, but finish redesigns and redesigns in general have consistently failed or hurt conversion (-6.6%).

candidates.title: Path Selection Account Persistence Safety Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint clarifying that both pet selection paths (preset or custom) automatically sync with your signed-in account.
candidates.why: Choose path drops conversion to 78.3% with a high mean duration of 514s.

choose_path.hint: You can customize or select a preset pet companion; both sync automatically to your account.

guard.reason: Adding a path selection hint clarifying account synchronization complies with all onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint for choose_path step, though previous single test on choose_path hint showed weak lift (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Pet Personality Persona Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated persona confirmation screen before adoption certificate to preview pet behavioral tendencies.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the biggest initial funnel drop (66.0%), needing strong emotional connection before certificate sign-off.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_persona_confirm']

candidates.title: Sign-In Session Restoration Alert Switch
candidates.change: Enables an explicit session restoration notification switch on the sign-in screen to confirm pet data protection.
candidates.why: Sign-in hints have a strong record of success (3 of 7 tests won), addressing 8 support tickets on missing pet data after login.

sign_in.hint: We will restore your previous pet setup automatically once signed in.

guard.reason: Enabling a session notification switch and hint on the sign-in screen adheres to all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Backed strongly by support emails for sign_in friction; notification changes show promise although untested specifically on sign_in.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interactive Stage Wait Indicator
candidates.change: Adds a continuous visual timer component and periodic status updates to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time is 201s median, and previous wait_info changes won 3 of 4 tests.

guard.reason: Adding a timer component during rendering on the waiting screen is permitted as it represents a real wait during pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Tackles 201s home wait duration using home wait_info, a strategy with 3 out of 4 past winning tests.
